provenance.purpose: Durable portable fixture for inventory discovery tests.
provenance.source: Synthetic values authored for this repository; no production code, APK bytes, credentials or private absolute paths.
provenance.regeneration: Fixture files are hand-maintained. Any intentional edit requires updating contracts.json (if discovery changes) and regenerating this manifest; cargo test fails on hash/byte or listing drift.
provenance.formatting: Durable fixture bytes are intentionally frozen. The .source-repo directory is hidden so pytest default norecursedirs excludes its test_*.py; Python fixture files start with "# ruff: noqa" and "# fmt: off" so Ruff check/format preserve bytes; the consumer fixture is .txt and Prettier only formats Markdown/selected configs, so these JSON/TOML/Python/text files are outside its scope. Recompute manifest hashes if a fixture is intentionally edited.
